cell_line.evidence: The probe, incorporating a pre-installed biotin group, bypasses the limitations of using a copper(I)-catalyzed click reaction in cell lysates for reporter group conjugation and revealed a broad range of olaparib interactors, including previously unreported proteins, in a quantitative mass spectrometry-based proteomic screening using HeLa whole cell lysate.
